verified.exploit_entry_point: The library's public API: the Address6 constructor and its special-range predicates. Only the advisory's own routes (T1 and T4, 13 cases) are covered by the security group; the functional group also runs the project's own functionality-v4/v6 mocha suites.
routes: T1: IPv4-mapped (::ffff:0:0/96) and NAT64 well-known (64:ff9b::/96) values through isLoopback, isLinkLocal, isMulticast, isUnspecified
T4: the NAT64 local-use block 64:ff9b:1::/48 through isPrivate
verified.project_tests_run: The project's own functionality-v4-test.ts and functionality-v6-test.ts (258 test cases) plus 11 hidden functional cases, on the pinned tree and on the reference fix.

traps.shape: an IPv6 value that carries an IPv4 address is classified by its wrapper, so a mapped loopback, link-local, multicast or unspecified address reads as ordinary global unicast
traps.reason_to_dismiss: isMapped4() already checks the mapped bits and getType() names the well-known NAT64 prefix, so the wrapper looks handled
traps.realistic_because: published advisory route (GHSA-22jq-vg5j-6vgg) at the pinned commit

traps.shape: the NAT64 local-use block has no public/internal answer; an embedded-address-only check leaves the whole block public
traps.reason_to_dismiss: getType() already returns 'NAT64 (local-use)' and the decode default is documented as the well-known prefix
